title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-eu0i: Stale doc comments referencing u32::MAX instead of 40-bit bound
description:
OscoreSeqNum::increment() and fetch_increment() doc comments say:
```
Returns None if the sequence number is at u32::MAX (would overflow).
```
But the actual bound is OscoreSeqNum::MAX = (1 << 40) - 1 (40-bit per RFC 8613 Section 5.2), not u32::MAX. The doc was not updated when the underlying type changed from u32 to 40-bit u64. Found in seqnum.rs lines 52 and 69.
